question: What does the speaker commit to doing for the beautiful-eyed one with respect to those mentioned?
premises: The speaker addresses the beautiful-eyed one.
The object is the method of names of those ones.
The speaker commits to speaking it and bids hearing.
inference: The speaker shall speak the method of names of those ones; the beautiful-eyed one is bid to hear.
uncertainties: The list of those ones is not given in this verse.
plain_english: O beautiful-eyed one, hear; I shall speak the method of names of them.
